control_profile: Controls off: unchanged buffered fast-breakout targets with no volatility scaling, drawdown brake, position stop, time stop, or turnover throttle.
falsifier: Reject the control-harm hypothesis if removing the overlay fails to improve weak-fold breadth, short-sleeve economics, or doubled-cost Sharpe without creating an unacceptable drawdown.
formation_horizon: twenty-day high-low channel with seven-day return confirmation
hypothesis: Frequent stop, time-stop, drawdown, and throttle interventions are interrupting the twice-weekly breakout portfolio; the raw targets should preserve winners and improve fold breadth when optional controls are removed.
rebalance_horizon: twice weekly at fixed UTC decision boundaries
